name: AVERAGE
description: AVERAGE returns the arithmetic mean of a set of numbers.
tldr: Calculates the mean of the provided numbers.

parameters.name: number1
parameters.description: The first number, range, or cell reference.

parameters.name: number2
parameters.description: Additional numbers, ranges, or cell references (optional).

basicExample.explanation: Adds all values in A2:A10 and divides by the count of numeric values.

advancedExamples.title: Average with multiple ranges
advancedExamples.explanation: Combines both ranges and computes the overall mean.

advancedExamples.title: Average excluding blanks
advancedExamples.description: AVERAGE ignores empty cells and text automatically
advancedExamples.explanation: Blank cells and text are ignored.

howItWorks: AVERAGE sums the numeric values and divides by the count of numeric values. It ignores text, logical values, and empty cells.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The mean appears in the cell.

limitations: Ignores text and empty cells, which may affect the denominator count.
Cells with logical TRUE/FALSE are ignored.

commonErrors.cause: No numeric values in the range.
commonErrors.fix: Ensure the range contains at least one number.

commonErrors.cause: Text-formatted numbers are treated as text.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: AVERAGE works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Does AVERAGE include zero?
faq.answer: Yes, zero is counted as a numeric value.

faq.question: How is AVERAGE different from AVERAGEA?
faq.answer: AVERAGEA counts text and FALSE as 0 and TRUE as 1.

faq.question: Can AVERAGE ignore errors?
faq.answer: No, use AVERAGEIF or FILTER to exclude errors.
